evals.prompt: I need to scrape all product listings from a competitor's e-commerce site and extract the product names, prices, and descriptions into structured JSON. The site uses React so pages are rendered client-side. Walk me through how to do this. Describe the calls and their parameters; do not run them. Use the web-scraping skill.
evals.expected_output: Should recommend firecrawl_map to discover URLs, then firecrawl_scrape with formats ["json"] and jsonOptions {prompt, schema} for structured extraction (one call per URL), or firecrawl_agent for unknown URLs. Should mention waitFor for JS-rendered pages. Should cover the full pipeline: discover URLs → filter → extract structured data → transform.
expectations: The answer discovers the product URLs with firecrawl_map
The answer extracts the fields with firecrawl_scrape using the json format and jsonOptions
The answer says to use waitFor for the client-rendered pages
The answer says to run one scrape call per URL
The answer mentions firecrawl_agent for the case that the URLs are not known
